title: Go, Preach My Gospel
print: the 1985 book's hymnary.org scan (p368.jpg), each line read off the page at its system and row; the rulings (data/crops/378/rulings.json) put in what the page prints where the base row differs: "brigh" -> "bright" (words, crops p368-266.jpg, judge-284 (Opus, effort max)).

stanzas.text: "Go, preach My gospel," saith the Lord;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: "Bid the whole world My grace receive;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 1. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: He shall be saved who trusts My word,
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 2, row 1. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))
p368.jpg system 3, row 1. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))
p368.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: And ye shall prove My gospel true
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 2. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: By all the works that I have done,
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 2, row 2. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: By all the wonders ye shall do.
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 3, row 2. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))
p368.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: I'm with you till the world shall end;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 3. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: All power is vested in My hands;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 2, row 3. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: I can destroy, and I defend."
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 3, row 3. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: He spake, and light shone round His head;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 4. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: On a bright cloud to heaven He rode;
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 1, row 4. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: They to the farthest nations spread
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 2, row 4. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

stanzas.text: The grace of their ascended Lord.
stanzas.from: p368.jpg system 3, row 4. (placed off the page by from-375 (Opus))

replaces.text:
"I'll make your great commission known,
And ye shall prove My gospel true
By all the works that I have done,
By all the wonders ye shall do.
